text_block_list.text:
It's time to train, but Грасс Вандер is
nowhere to
be seen. I go looking for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer. Have a look at this book.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's such a popular title, it rarely stays on
the shelf
at the library, but I finally
managed to borrow a
copy.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It's a lovely piece of literature
thoroughly
explaining the roots of
Japanese culture.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It even includes seasonal pictures of
places which
haven't lost their beauty
even after a
millennium. ♪
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Would you like to see them as well,
Тренер?
You're sure to find one to your
liking.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Oh! I-I'm so sorry. How could I be so
careless?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
It completely slipped my mind. I promise
to be
more attentive in the future.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
She seems genuinely sorry, so I give her
the day
off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
